title: Yeasty Tender Filipino Olive Dumplings
description: A lacto-vegetarian Filipino dish featuring olives and dumplings, perfect for meal prep. This recipe yields tender and yeasty dumplings filled with a savory olive mixture.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add olive oil, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a separate bowl, mix chopped olives, onion, and vegetable broth.
Divide the risen dough into 8 equal pieces and shape into balls.
Flatten each ball into a disk and place a tablespoon of olive mixture in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling and seal the edges.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with milk and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
